title: Incorporating context and co-occurring internal processes into psychophysiological research
title_zh: 将情境与共存内部过程纳入心理生理学研究
abstract: The field of psychophysiology is characterized by its use of rigorous methodological approaches to understand exchanges between the human body and its surrounding environment. However, a majority of the research to date has focused on the use of single psychophysiological measures for processes of interest within lab-based settings. We present a conceptual paper where we draw expertise from two complementary disciplines, psychology and anthropology, to discuss key opportunities and challenges. We argue for the consideration of context and co-occurring internal processes into psychophysiological research. We focus on neural and cardiac assessments of how individuals respond to surrounding environments with an eye toward understanding risk for psychopathology. We offer recommendations for researchers to incorporate multimethod approaches across various settings, as well as note limitations, considerations, and opportunities.
abstract_zh: 心理生理学领域以严谨的方法学方法来理解人体与其周围环境之间的相互作用为特征。然而，迄今为止的大多数研究主要集中在实验室环境中使用单一心理生理测量来研究感兴趣的过程。本文是一篇概念性论文，我们借鉴心理学和人类学这两门互补学科的专业知识，讨论关键机遇与挑战。我们主张在心理生理学研究中考虑情境和共存的内部过程。重点关注神经和心脏评估个体对周围环境的反应，以期理解精神病理学风险。我们为研究者提供了在不同环境中整合多方法的建议，并指出了局限性、注意事项和机遇。
